subject: A small question about the hallway storage note
text:
Hello,

I hope you are well. I am writing because I noticed a small problem with the note about the shared hallway storage. The instruction says to clear the area by Thursday, but it is unclear whether the small cabinet behind the door is included. I do not want to move anything by mistake. I also could not tell if the boxes with recycling labels should be removed or left for later.

Would you mind clarifying this when you have a moment? I can wait until after the meeting if needed. I just wanted to mention it early so the task stays simple. There is no urgent issue at the moment. I only wanted to check before making assumptions. The wording could mean either thing. I am sorry to bother you with such a detail. It may be obvious to others. I did not want to guess. The corridor still looks tidy for now. I will avoid touching the shelf if that is safer. I appreciate your help. The building notice was posted briefly. I only read it once. I did not take notes. This can easily be fixed. Please let me know.
